tei:div.tei:p: (ta)༄༅// 'jam dbyangs kyi bstod pa rgyud gsum 'khor lo bzhugs// ༄༅// mtshungs med bla ma'i zhabs la phyag byas nas// dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi yab gyur pa'i// 'jam dpal 'jam dbyangs 'jam pa'i rdo rje la// dad pas bstod pa 'di ni brjod par bgyi// drag po 'phrog byed dbyig gi snying po dang*// sreg byed mig stong gtsug gi nor bu yis// 'jam mgon zhabs kyi 'dam skyes rtag mchod pa// bdag kyang khyod kyi zhabs rdul spyi bos len// sangs rgyas kun gyis rtag tu rab bsngags shing*// sa bcu'i rgyal sras rnams dang rang rgyal gtso// dgra bcom chen po kun gyis rtag bstod mod// bdag kyang snyan ngag me tog snyim pas mchod// rgyal ba kun gyis rtag tu dgongs gyur cing*// 'phags pa'i tshogs kyi the tshom gcod pa po// skye dgu rnams kyi skyabs gyur bcom ldan 'das// dad pas rtag tu bdag ni skyabs su mchi// btso ma gser dang gur gum mdangs 'dra zhing*// ral gri utpal glegs bam gyis mdzes pa// ral pa'i cod paṇa rin chen dar gyis brgyan// sna tshogs gdan steng brjid pas bzhugs la 'dud// rab dkar anda rnyil dang margad mtshungs// li khri'i mdog mtshungs phyed gzugs du ma'i mdangs// nam mkha'i khams kun gom pa gcig gis gnon// phyag mtshan du mas sgeg la bdag phyag 'tshal// sangs rgyas thams cad skyed pa'i yab gyur kyang*// byis pa'i gzugs 'dzin gzhon nu'i mtshan ldan zhing*// rab bgres 'jig rten dbang phyug rdo rje 'dzin// kun gyi bla mar mdzad la mgos phyag 'tshal// 'jam pa'i mtshan ldan rab tu zhi ba yis// mtha' yas sems can tshogs rnams bsgral mod kyi// gdug cing gtum pa'i 'gro ba bsgral ba'i phyir// gshin rje 'joms mdzad khyod la mgos phyag 'tshal// khyod sku khros pa'i rnam 'phrul mtha' yas mdzod// gang mthong khro bo kun gyi lag cha shor// bdud dang log 'dren kun gyi snying rab gas// ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal skem pa'i dpal la 'dud// la lar dkyil 'khor gtso bo la lar 'khor// la lar sangs rgyas gyur nas zhing rnams skyong*// rgyal ba'i sras la sangs rgyas sprul pa 'gyed// zhing khams du ma ba spu'i bu gar snang*// rang rgyal dgra bcom dang ni brtul zhugs bzang*// la lar tshangs dbang 'jug sel la sogs pa// rnam 'phrul mtha' yas mdzad pa du ma yis// ma lus sems can don mdzad khyod la 'dud// 'jam pa'i gsung ldan rig byed dran pa'i dbyangs// yi ge lnga ni chos rnams kun gyi sgo// blo mchog yi ge gcig pa'i gsung gis ni// 'gro ba mtha' dag sgrol la mgos phyag 'tshal// oṃ gyi nga ro 'jam pas rab drangs nas// drag po'i yi ge sum cu gnyis la sogs// rab zab rig sngags du ma'i tshogs rnams kyis// gdug pa'i tshogs 'joms dbyangs la bdag phyag 'tshal// chos sku rab tu zhi ba 'jam pa'i ngang*// gnyis med longs spyod rdzogs pa rdo rje'i sku// zung 'jug thugs rje chen pos 'gro don mdzad// ye shes lnga yi thugs la bdag phyag 'tshal// sangs rgyas gaṅgā'i klung gi bye snyed kyi// mtshan rnams bskal par brjod pa'i bsod nams pas// 'jam dpal lan cig brjod pa ches mchog ces// bden par gsung gis bdag la byin gyis rlobs// skom pas nyen pa'i 'gro ba du ma zhig

/chu klung chen po'i drung du lhags gyur te// 'thungs pas rab tshim dga' bar gyur mod kyang*// chu la bri bar gyur ba cung zad med// de bzhin 'jam dbyangs chos kyi rgya mtsho la// rgyal ba rgyal sras rang rgyal dgra las rgyal// skye bo'i tshogs kyis bstod par gyur mod kyang*// yon tan rgya mtsho mi zad khyod la 'dud// srid par 'dod pa'i sdug bsngal zhi mdzad cing*// rigs can gsum na rang rang sa la 'jog /kun kyang rim gyis sangs rgyas sar 'jog pa'i// phrin las mtha' yas khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// de ltar 'jam dbyangs bstod pa'i bsod nams kyis// mkha' mnyam sems can kun gyi snang ba la// 'jam dbyangs ye shes nyi ma shar gyur te// 'gro ba'i ma rig dpyis 'byin byed par shog /skye bo bdag 'dzin mun pas rab g.yogs nas// spros bral thar pa'i bde gnas mi shes pa// de dag kun la zung 'jug bde ba'i lam// ye shes sgron ma rtag tu ston par shog /byang chub sems kyi rin chen las byung ba'i// bdag kyang blo mchog 'jam dbyangs nyid gyur nas// nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can rnams// dri med sangs rgyas sa la 'jog par shog /rje btsun 'phags pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi bstod pa rgyud gsum gyi 'khor lo zhes bya ba shākya'i dge bsnyen theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis nye bar sbyar ba 'di yongs su rdzogs so// nyes pa mchis na bla ma dam pa rnams kyi spyan sngar bshags shing*/ dge ba rnams sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas te rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas su bsngo'o/// / ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
